cat > diag1.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
tab = np.loadtxt("data/pilot.csv", delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
X, y = (tab[:, :-1], tab[:, -1])
n, p = X.shape
print("pilot shape", X.shape, "labels", np.bincount((y > 0).astype(int)))

F, _ = f_classif(X, y)
order = np.argsort(-F)
print("top-60 F:")
for i in range(60):
    print(f"  x{order[i]+1:<4d} F={F[order[i]]:8.2f}", end="")
    if i % 4 == 3:
        print()
print()
# elbow: F values sorted
print("sorted top-80 F:", np.round(np.sort(F)[-80:][::-1], 1))
print("quantiles of F:", np.percentile(F, [50, 75, 90, 95, 99]).round(2))

# bootstrap stability of top-K membership (K=30), subsample 50% without replacement
B = 200
top = order[:60]
counts = np.zeros(p)
rank_sums = np.zeros(p)
for b in range(B):
    idx = rng.choice(n, size=n // 2, replace=False)
    Fb, _ = f_classif(X[idx], y[idx])
    ob = np.argsort(-Fb)
    rank_sums[ob] += np.arange(1, p + 1)
    counts[ob[:30]] += 1
print("\nstability of top-60 by full-pilot F (freq in top-30 across 200 half-samples):")
for i in top:
    print(f"  x{i+1:<4d} F={F[i]:8.2f} freq={counts[i]:.3f} mean_rank={rank_sums[i]/B:8.1f}")
np.save("out_F.npy", F)
EOF
